messages:
Priya M.: Heads up — found a duplicated usage line on BlueOrbit's March AWS Marketplace invoice. Two entries appear to bill the same tokens twice, looks like a dimension vs dimension_total issue.

Liam B.: can you paste the invoice id and the lines?

Priya M.: INV-2025-03-00972
Lines excerpt:
```
Line 117: SUB-8765 | metering.dimension=token_usage | qty=12,300 | charge=$123.00
Line 118: SUB-8765 | metering.dimension=token_usage_total | qty=12,300 | charge=$123.00
```
Same qty/amount, different meterDimension.

Sam K.: we had a small ingestion burst on 2025-03-05; our normalizer may have produced both lines when AWS emitted two dimension names.

Liam B.: pulling the ingestion trace for that invoice now. give me a min.

billing-bot: Ingest job run: marketplace-us-east-1-usage-ingest v2025.03.05 completed. 72,482 events processed. 29 events flagged as "ambiguous-dimension".

Jules P.: BlueOrbit raised this via their AM — they want a quick credit and an explanation for their customer.

Liam B.: confirmed: usage_id matches across both meterDimensions and timestamps align. Our billing transform collapses identical dimension names only, so both made it through.

Priya M.: decision: full credit for the duplicate line or partial?

Sam K.: recommend crediting the second line only ($123.00). We should avoid crediting if it's genuinely additive, but here it's a duplicate. I'll add a note in Partner Ops.

Liam B.: I'll prepare the credit memo and JE. Please note accounting sign-off required before issuing refund.

Priya M.: tagging for audit: adding this thread as record. Sam/Jules, can you update the partner ticket with the planned correction and the PR link for the fix?

Jules P.: yes — updating ticket CHANNEL-4521 now: "Issued credit to BlueOrbit for duplicate AWS metering dimension on INV-2025-03-00972. Remediation: billing normalize to dedupe by usage_id+subscription_id; PR linked."

billing-bot: Remediation suggestion: add transform dedupe_by = ["usage_id","subscription_id","metering_dimension"] and prefer_primary_dimensions = ["token_usage","embeddings_usage"]. Created PR #801 in billing-ingest repo.

Liam B.: draft Credit Memo attached to ticket: 
```
Credit Memo: CM-2025-04-112
Customer: BlueOrbit
Original Invoice: INV-2025-03-00972
Amount Credited: $123.00
Reason: Duplicate metering dimension (token_usage_total)
```

Sam K.: scheduling replay of the 2025-03-05 ingestion window to scan for other affected subscriptions. Will paste results when done.

Priya M.: thanks — I'll wait for accounting confirmation before closing.

Jules P.: BlueOrbit rep acknowledged the credit, says downstream customer will see refund in 3-5 business days.

billing-bot: Postmortem skeleton created: PM-2025-03-dupe-metering. Owner Sam K., due 2025-04-10.

Liam B.: JE and memo queued, emailing finance@redwood.com now. ETA 45m. :thumbsup:

Priya M.: perfect. leaving for signoff.

(END)
